title: KServe V2 RAFM fraud inference request
description: Request schema for the supplied ONNX BalancedRandomForest artifact served by MLServer under KServe V2.

FeatureRow.description: One transaction feature row after training-time Plan_Type one-hot preprocessing.

name.description: KServe tensor name read from deployed model metadata/feature manifest; the supplied pipeline exports float_input.

prefixItems.description: Feature count declared by the deployed ordered feature manifest.

datatype.description: KServe V2 FP32 input tensor type.

data.description: Rows align with shape[0]; every row width equals shape[1] and follows the artifact manifest after Plan_Type one-hot encoding with drop_first semantics.

InputTensor.description: Single ONNX input matrix for a bounded transaction batch.

inputs.description: Exactly one FP32 feature matrix tensor.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

name.description: Class-output tensor name from the artifact manifest. The consumer selects exactly one tensor with this name, independently of response tensor order.

prefixItems.description: Number of class IDs; equals input batch size.

shape.description: One result per row: [batch], or the MLServer NumPy codec shape [batch, 1].

datatype.description: ONNX metadata supplies the class tensor datatype. BOOL labels and INT64 class indices are both normalized to canonical class IDs; exact artifact metadata is an open question.

oneOf.description: Integer class index; 0 is Non-Fraud and 1 is Fraud.
Boolean class label; false is Non-Fraud and true is Fraud.

items.description: Raw model class output, normalized according to the deployed ONNX class metadata.

data.description: One class ID per input transaction, preserving input order.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

name.description: Auxiliary probability-output tensor name from ONNX metadata; it must differ from the selected class tensor name.

prefixItems.description: One probability for each class in the trained [Non-Fraud, Fraud] order.

shape.description: Dense class-probability tensor [batch, 2] emitted by the supplied zipmap=False ONNX export.

datatype.description: Numeric probability tensor datatype reported by ONNX metadata.

data.description: Flattened tensor data containing exactly batch times two probabilities. Probabilities are auxiliary and do not replace the model's class output.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

id.description: Request ID echoed by the inference server.

model_version.description: Served artifact version, recorded with prediction results.

outputs.description: Exactly one named binary class-output tensor, optionally accompanied by the dense probability tensor from the supplied ONNX export. Tensor names must be unique; response order is not significant.

x-response-validation.identity: Require model_name fraud-prediction and a model_version equal to the validated artifact manifest.
x-response-validation.selection: Require unique names across all output tensors and exactly one class tensor whose name equals manifest.output_tensor_name; reject missing or duplicate selected names.
x-response-validation.class_tensor: Require shape [input_batch_size], matching flat data length, and class values of the declared BOOL or INT64 datatype. Normalize false/0 to Non-Fraud and true/1 to Fraud.
x-response-validation.probability_tensor: If present, require shape [input_batch_size, 2], matching flat data length, and finite numeric probabilities in [0, 1]. Do not derive or override class labels from this auxiliary tensor.

x-contract-guarantees.side_effects: Stateless inference; the model service does not mutate application database rows.
x-contract-guarantees.errors: Invalid tensor, model not ready, invalid model name, and artifact storage failures use KServe V2 error responses and map to INVALID_TENSOR, MODEL_NOT_READY, INVALID_MODEL_NAME, or STORAGE_ERROR.
x-contract-guarantees.timeouts_retries: Prediction-tools sets a 30 second per-batch deadline and retries one transient readiness/5xx failure after 500 milliseconds; invalid tensors and artifact mismatches are not retried.
x-contract-guarantees.ordering: Exactly one class output is returned per input transaction and input order is preserved.
x-contract-guarantees.versioning: KServe V2 tensor schema, ordered feature manifest, and binary class order are pinned with the ONNX artifact.

x-preprocessing.source: Supplied RAFM fraud training/serving pipeline at commit 3037c340c5a4a27ae53f95b9146562c12c985c79.
x-preprocessing.transform: Plan_Type one-hot encoding with training-time drop_first semantics; the exact ordered feature names and width come from the deployed artifact feature manifest.
x-preprocessing.unresolved_artifact_metadata: The supplied pipeline exports input tensor float_input. Confirm the deployed model version, class/probability output names and datatypes, and ordered feature manifest against the actual artifacts.
